en: fry onions until soft and golden

does: Cooks sliced or chopped onions in fat over a medium heat until they are soft and lightly golden, so that they are sweet with a little browned depth.
how: Heat a little fat in a wide pan over a medium heat.
Add the onions with a little salt and stir to coat them.
Cook, stirring now and then, until they are soft and turn golden at the edges. Lower the heat if they brown faster than they soften.

cues.text: Soft, slumped onions, golden with a few browner edges.
A sweet, toasty onion smell, never a sharp or burnt one.

mistakes.mistake: Turning up the heat to save time, so that the onions scorch outside while they are still crisp.
mistakes.fix: Keep the heat medium and give them the time they need.

mistakes.mistake: Crowding them into a small pan, so that they steam pale.
mistakes.fix: Spread them out in a wide pan.

variant_of.differs: The heat is a little higher and the onions are allowed to take a light golden colour, rather than kept pale.
